# Step 2.241 — builder one (item 1 of 4 done; items 2 and 3 not started)

**What exists (layer 1, below the screens).**

- `packages/core/src/modules/games/statistic-of-tap.ts` (+ test): `statisticOfTap` (turnover, unturnover, team-turnover, team-unturnover name `turnovers`; nothing else names a statistic, since points and fouls are kept in every live-tracked season), `keptForScoring(seasonRules)` (= `statisticsKept([], rules)`), `tapNotKept`. Not yet exported from the games `index.ts`; item 2 needs it there.
- `apply-tracker-commands.ts`: a play whose statistic the season does not keep is refused before the engine, about that tap alone; the plays after it are taken. It reads the season's rules as they stand (`tx.games.findSeason`), not the rules the game kept, so it agrees with the public pages.
- Contracts (`tracker-protocol.ts`): refusal code `statistic-not-kept`, `tapRefusalCodes`/`isTapRefusal`, and the batch field `knownRefusals` (T-391). The server says the new code only to a batch naming it; any other batch gets `rule` with the same message, because an older tracker reads an unknown code as no answer and would resend for ever.
- Tracker queue (`tracker-queue.ts`): both tap codes set the tap aside into the existing `notApplied` list (steps 2.148/2.70/2.242; no second list); version 2 batches name `knownRefusals`. The send-these-plays batch (`tracker-controller.ts`) names it too; a refused play stays on the not-saved list, as a `rule` refusal does.
- Copy upload (step 2.70, `game-copy-upload-endpoint.ts`, unchanged): its batches name no `knownRefusals`, so such a play is refused `rule` and counted in `notTaken`; the copy is answered `uploaded`, never `damaged`. No test of this yet.
- Test helper `keepingTurnovers` (`apps/web/src/server/tracker-endpoints.test-helper.ts`) and `trackerWorld({ deps })`: the stand-in seasons all keep the standard set, so three web tests that tap turnovers now play in a season keeping `full`.
- Decision `docs/specs/v1/decisions-pending/T-391.md`.

**What ran and passed.** `packages/core/src/modules/games` 53 files, 494 tests; `apps/web/src/features/tracker` + tracker endpoint, copy-upload and stand-in-world tests + `packages/contracts`: 72 files, 938 tests at the time of the change, then `scoring-screen.test.ts` 25/25 with the new set-aside test; `npm run check`; `npm run typecheck`; `tests/pending-decisions.test.mjs`. Each new test was failed once by breaking the code by hand (check removed: 4 fail; code always `rule`: 1 fails; queue halting on the new code: 1 fails). No browser test was run.
